info.name: Feature Flag Manager · integrated workflow
info.description:
Phase 3 integrated test (S3, Ebrahim). Runs the whole product as a user would, then the role, ownership and input checks.

Week 6 demo path: log in → create a flag → turn it on in staging → 25% rollout → client app evaluates it with an API key → both changes in the audit log → a prod change raises an alert → GitHub issue (or a recorded failure when no token is set) → CSV export → monitoring.

Needs an environment with baseUrl, adminEmail, devEmail, otherTeamEmail, password and stagingKey (see README.md). Run it on a fresh cookie jar. Each run makes its own flags (key suffix = run id), so it can be repeated.

Test IDs in request names refer to docs/api-test-plan.md.

exec: pm.test('prod_change alert raised for that event', () => { pm.expect(a).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(a.rule).to.eql('prod_change'); });

pm.test('delivery finished: sent, or failed with a reason', () => { pm.expect(['sent', 'failed']).to.include(a.status); if (a.status === 'failed') pm.expect(a.lastError).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.test('201/200 when GitHub works, 502 when it does not', () => pm.expect([200, 201, 502]).to.include(code));
pm.test('the token never appears in the response', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/github_pat_|ghp_/));

request.description: With a working GITHUB_TOKEN: 201 (or 200 if the first attempt already opened it). Without one: 502 UPSTREAM_FAILED and the alert stays failed.
